title: $\mathtt{DistP}$: Scaling Local-Update Training with Zero-Shot Hyperparameter Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2611.27808v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Local-update methods offer a communication-efficient alternative to Distributed Data Parallelism ($\mathtt{DDP}$), but introduce additional hyperparameters that require costly tuning. For $\mathtt{DDP}$, zero-shot hyperparameter transfer reduces this cost by reusing settings tuned on smaller models, but its applicability to local-update training remains unclear. We propose $\mathtt{DistP}$, a theoretical framework extending existing transfer rules from $\mathtt{DDP}$ to local-update training with varying worker counts, local steps, and outer optimizers. With averaging as the outer optimizer, $\mathtt{DistP}$ supports learning-rate transfer across width and depth while improving model quality. translated_title: $\mathtt{DistP}$：通过零样本超参数迁移扩展本地更新训练
translated_abstract: 本地更新方法为分布式数据并行（$\mathtt{DDP}$）提供了一种通信高效的替代方案，但引入了需要昂贵调优的额外超参数。对于$\mathtt{DDP}$，零样本超参数迁移通过复用在较小模型上调优的设置来降低这一成本，但其在本地更新训练中的适用性仍不明确。我们提出了$\mathtt{DistP}$，一个理论框架，将现有的迁移规则从$\mathtt{DDP}$扩展到具有不同工作节点数量、本地步数和外层优化器的本地更新训练。当使用平均作为外层优化器时，$\mathtt{DistP}$支持学习率在宽度和深度上的迁移，同时提升模型质量。调优后的内层学习率还可以直接在不同同步间隔之间迁移，但在增加全局批量大小（batch size）时遵循两种规律：对于较大的本地批量采用平方根学习率缩放，对于其他情况则采用固定的参考学习率（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 提出理论框架$\mathtt{DistP}$，将$\mathtt{DDP}$的零样本超参数迁移规则扩展到本地更新训练，使学习率能够跨模型宽度、深度和同步间隔直接迁移，从而免去昂贵的超参数调优。
en_tdlr: Proposes $\mathtt{DistP}$, a theoretical framework that extends zero-shot hyperparameter transfer rules from $\mathtt{DDP}$ to local-update training, enabling learning rates to transfer directly across model width, depth, and synchronization intervals without costly tuning.
